how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-naxxramas-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9033:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ at ⟦E2⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ wants you to slay 5 Living Monstrosities, 5 Stoneskin Gargoyles, 8 Deathknight Captains and 3 Venom Stalkers.
rows.quest:9033:details:0: Five years since the last war...
rows.quest:9033:details:1: Tens of thousands of lives were lost and for what? The threat was never fully extinguished.
rows.quest:9033:details:2: And so the Lich King stirs once more... His yes-man, Kel'Thuzad, amassing for another attack upon our lands.
rows.quest:9033:details:3: We will not allow it! Prove your dedication. Prove that you are willing to risk life and limb to stop this madness and the combined might of the Dawn and the Crusade will be at your beck and call.
rows.quest:9033:details:4: Enter ⟦E5⟧ and destroy the Scourge within...
rows.quest:9033:progress:0: Duty, honor, dedication... What do these words mean to you?
rows.quest:9033:completion:0: A job well done! You will be rewarded via the services of the men and women at Light's ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:9120:obj:0: Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to ⟦E2⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:9120:details:0: The phylactery is all that remains of the master of ⟦E5⟧. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.
rows.quest:9120:details:1: Someone at Light's ⟦E6⟧ will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
rows.quest:9120:progress:0: BLESSED LIGHT! What foulness do you hold, boy?
rows.quest:9120:completion:0: In all my days of living I would have never expected to see this... ⟦1⟧ Oh yes, you will be rewarded dear boy. You will be greatly rewarded. Give it here. Now!
rows.quest:9229:details:0: Ramaladni was a warrior of the Brotherhood - a pupil of Highlord Mograine before the Dawn even existed! When news of Mograine's death reached him, hatred and anger took over.
rows.quest:9229:details:1: Understand this, ⟦2⟧, when rage and retribution take the reins, a man ceases to be a man. The man personifies the emotions that control him instead. And so it would be that Ramaladni, the spirit of retribution, would enter ⟦E5⟧ to exact vengeance... and never return.
rows.quest:9229:details:2: Enter ⟦E5⟧ and find what became of Ramaladni.
rows.quest:9229:completion:0: It is his ring! But it is destroyed. No other evidence of Ramaladni was found?
rows.quest:9229:completion:2: This does not bode well for Ramaladni. The ring, however... it might be salvageable.
rows.quest:9230:obj:0: Korfax at ⟦E2⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ wants you to bring him 1 ⟦E8⟧, 1 ⟦E9⟧ and 1 ⟦E10⟧.⟦3⟧
rows.quest:9230:details:0: Fixing this band may prove to be quite challenging, ⟦4⟧. You see, it was made from the very runes that form inside Scourge structures - like ⟦E5⟧. Additional materials are also required but your main concern should be getting those frozen runes. Bring me what I need and I will restore the ring to its former glory.
rows.quest:9230:progress:0: Frozen runes could probably be found inside ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:9230:completion:0: Ramaladni himself couldn't have done better! Here is the ring, as promised.
rows.quest:9232:obj:0: ⟦E12⟧ at ⟦E2⟧ in the ⟦E3⟧ wants you to bring him 2 ⟦E13⟧, 2 ⟦E14⟧, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
rows.quest:9232:details:0: You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in ⟦E5⟧?
rows.quest:9232:details:2: Bah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you.
rows.quest:9232:details:3: Omarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
rows.quest:9232:progress:0: You haven't run into Omarion, have you?
rows.quest:9232:completion:0: <Wilhelm wipes the sweat from his brow.>
rows.quest:9232:completion:1: That's some hard work! Enjoy the pants, ⟦5⟧. At least you'll die in a clean pair now.
rows.quest:9233:details:1: If you are reading this, I have perished - finally. I want you to know that my dying thoughts revolved around you and your ineptitude when it comes to tradeskills. Unfortunately, the bearer of this handbook is in even worse shape than you in regards to crafting.
rows.quest:9233:details:2: About the book: These are the rest of my recipes. Make the bearer of this book whatever they request. I'm sure you will charge a hefty fee for your services because you are, after all, a bastard.
rows.quest:9233:progress:0: Is that what I think it is?⟦7⟧⟦8⟧<Wilhelm appears to be drooling.>
rows.quest:9233:completion:0: He musta really been off his rocker when he wrote this! Omarion and I - we were thick as thieves!
rows.quest:9233:completion:1: Anyhow, this certainly opens up some new possibilities, ⟦9⟧. I am now able to craft more items - for a small fee and material charges, of course.

rows.quest:9234:details:0: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icebane gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
rows.quest:9234:completion:0: Here is your order, ⟦10⟧. Delivered as promised!
